run2_source_note: CMS-SUS-19-010 (arXiv:2103.01290, Phys. Rev. D 104 (2021) 052001, 137 fb^-1), Figure 8-a (T2tt: pp -> stop stop -> t tbar chi10 chi10), all-hadronic (0-lepton) final state, 95% CL exclusion contours. Central observed/expected exclusion contour lines from HEPData record ins1849522 (hepdata.net record 103065 v1), tables 'Figure 08-a Observed Lines' (t21, central group 'Observed Exclusion Contour') and 'Figure 08-a Expected Lines' (t22, central group 'Expected Exclusion Contour'), retrieved via the hepdata.net /record/data/103065/<tableid>/1 API. Note: CMS public-results ROOT/CSV files for this analysis return HTTP 404 (not published), and the HEPData /download/table endpoints are blocked by Cloudflare; the record/data JSON API is the working official source. Points are [mStop_GeV, mLSP_GeV] ordered along the contour.
